title: Finn Duels Kylo Ren
description: Ren takes a step back, then thrusts the fiery Lightsaber blade close to Finn's chest. Finn lifts his Lightsaber and manages to block the attack just in time. But Kylo Ren keeps swinging, faster and faster. Finn uses every ounce of his combat training to fight Kylo, but it isn't enough.
